title: Weekly AI Worldview | eHealthNow Near-¥100M Series C; Figma at $12.5B; Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs Hits $1B

author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly digest · July 22, 2024

China funding

LimX Dynamics (逐际动力) — general-purpose humanoid/quad/biped robots (est. 2022, Shenzhen); Series A strategic led by Alibaba, China Merchants Venture, Shangqi Capital; FreeS, Oasis, MiraclePlus follow. Manufacturing, inspection, logistics, special ops, home service; AI on humanoids + real-scene iteration.

eHealthNow / Huamei Haolian (华美浩联) — AI healthcare platform; ~¥100M Series C from Ameba Capital, Ventech China, Fengqiao Capital. Founded 2017; B2B2C for insurers, banks, enterprises, hospitals. Products “Hua Doctor AI GP” / “precise care”; covers 1,312 Class-III hospitals; 30M+ users.

Houmo.ai (后摩智能) — compute-in-memory chips; hundreds of millions RMB strategic led by China Mobile digital-economy / digital-transformation funds (Beijing & Shanghai). Founded end-2020 by Dr. Wu Qiang; edge/cloud inference & training for robotaxis etc.; target first domestic 1,000 TOPS single-chip.

Chiplet Alliance / Xinmeng (芯盟科技) — heterogeneous integration; multi-billion RMB Series B with Jingque Capital industrial funds. Founded 2018 Haining; vertical-channel 3D memory without costly EUV; VCAT + HITOC™ bonding commercial; team from SMIC, Intel.

Kunlun Yuan (昆仑元) — full-stack AI (est. 2024); angel led by Jiusong Shanhe. Native LLMs, multimodal, AI OS, edge; GenAI terminals + agent platforms.

Xiaoyu Zhizao (小雨智造) — general robot “brain”; ¥100M seed from Xiaomi, robotics expert Wang Tianmiao, BAAI. Founded early 2023; Xiaomi-alumni founders Qiao Zhongliang (MIUI) & Wang Wenlin (“Xiaomi Brain” / IoT); industrial first.

Overseas funding

Beeble AI — AI virtual studio (ex-Krafton AI); $4.75M seed led by Basis Set; Fika; valuation $25M. SwitchLight → Virtual Studio; profitable since Oct; 3M users; ReelShort integration.

Mantra — AI manga translation (Tokyo Univ spinout); ¥780M JPY led by top Japanese publishers; team to ~35 by 2025; expand to novels/games/video.

Captions — AI video; $60M Series C led by Index; total ~$100M; valuation $500M. AI Creator / Edit / Lipdub; 10M+ creators; 3M+ videos/month; team 15→60.

Exa — AI-native search; $17M Series A Lightspeed, NVentures, YC; cumulative $22M. Vector/embedding link prediction; API for bots & datasets.

Anysphere (Cursor) — AI code editor; new round; valuation $400M. Used at OpenAI, Perplexity; prior $8M OpenAI Startup Fund seed.

Kindo — AI security management; $20.6M led by Drive Capital; RRE, Marlinspike. Acquired open-source WhiteRabbitNeo.

WorkerHero — AI hiring (DACH); €4M Series A Mediahuis, 10x Founders, Bonsai; 70k+ users; Telekom, HelloFresh.

Presti — AI furniture product photos (SDXL); $3.5M seed Partech + angels (Thibaud Elzière).

Shaped — AI recommendations; $8M Series A Madrona, YC + execs. Founders ex-Facebook AI / Uber / Afterpay.

Amity (Thailand SaaS AI) — $60M Series C total: Amity Solutions $41.6M Insight Capital; Amity Corp $18.4M SMDV; AlteriQ debt. Founded 2012 by Korawad Chearavanont; Amity Bots / Voice / Eko; genAI apps; ~35–40% revenue Thailand; listing prep.

Figma — new round / secondary led by Coatue et al.; valuation $12.5B. ARR >$700M, path >$1B next year; SurgoCap, Atlassian; AI features + Figma Slides; IPO talk.

Pindrop — deepfake detection; $100M 5-year loan from Hercules Capital; expand beyond banking/finance to healthcare, retail.

Arrcus — virtual routing; $27M with Nvidia, Prosperity7, Hitachi Ventures, General Catalyst.

Leya — legal AI (Sweden); $25M Series A Redpoint, Benchmark, YC. Founded 2023.

Artificial Agency — AI behavior engine for game NPCs (ex-DeepMind); $16M Radical + Toyota Ventures (prior $4M seed; CN notes total $16M).

.lumen — AI glasses for the blind (Romania); €9M (SeedBlink €5M + EIC et al.). PAD AI haptic “guide dog”; 300+ testers / 30 countries; limited 2024 Q4; U.S. 2025 Q4; 10k units by end-2026.

Events

Zhipu AI — Beijing fund with partners; registered capital ¥260M (Xinglian Dingsen).

Alibaba Cloud — GPU cloud upgrade; AI LLM app performance up to +100% via DeepNCCL; ACK cloud-native AI suite.

SenseTime — Jueying multimodal model on-vehicle; first-packet latency <300ms; 40 tokens/s; HyperPPL; used on Shenzhen’s first autonomous bus route.

LG Energy Solution — AI battery design model: design in 1 day vs ~2 weeks; trained on 100k cases / 30+ years know-how.

Anthropic × Menlo — $100M Anthology Fund (pre-seed/seed/A); Menlo also >$750M undisclosed into Anthropic; from Menlo’s $1.35B fund; min $100k + $25k Anthropic credits.

Samsung acquires Oxford Semantic Technologies (UK knowledge graphs; amount undisclosed) for on-device AI / Galaxy S24+.

OpenAI GPT-4o Mini — $0.15 / $0.60 per 1M input/output tokens; MMLU 82%; 128K context; knowledge cutoff Oct 2023; free ChatGPT users + Plus/Teams; Enterprise next week.

Proton Scribe — privacy-first AI email writing in Proton Mail; local hardware option; English-only initially.

Google ↔ Wiz — talks on ~$23B acquisition (WSJ); Wiz valued $12B earlier; IPO plans may shift.

People

Jiang Guofei — ex-Ant SVP → China Electronics chief scientist (data elements + AI). Ant Digital now independently capitalized (+¥2B); Zhao Wenpiao CEO; Ni Xingjun chair.

Fei-Fei Li — World Labs (Apr); valuation $1B in ~4 months; ~$100M raise with a16z, Radical; “spatial intelligence.” PitchBook: U.S. AI startups >$27B in prior 3 months (~half of all startup funding).

Andrej Karpathy — Eureka Labs; free undergrad AI course LLM101n; AI teaching assistants; education free, monetize elsewhere.

Zhou Chang — Tongyi Qianwen technical backbone reportedly leaving Alibaba to found (AI apps); R&D/open-source continues under Alibaba Cloud CTO Zhou Jingren.

— END —
